name: Clean Professional Frontend Redesign
description: Redesign the Topos marketing homepage (page.tsx) and supporting design system (globals.css, Logo) to achieve a clean, simple, professional aesthetic that matches the TOPOS name — architectural minimalism, generous whitespace, refined typography, restrained color — replacing the current ornamental Aegean-themed design.

goal.answer: Redesign the Topos marketing homepage (page.tsx) and supporting design system (globals.css, Logo) to achieve a clean, simple, professional aesthetic that matches the TOPOS name — architectural minimalism, generous whitespace, refined typography, restrained color — replacing the current ornamental Aegean-themed design. Typography: keep Playfair Display for large headlines only (editorial elegance), Inter for all body/UI text (clean, modern).

criteria.answer:
Homepage (src/app/page.tsx) renders with a clean, minimal layout — no decorative arch SVGs, no meander dividers, no plaster textures, no blur orbs
globals.css uses a refined, restrained color palette — primary accent retained, terracotta/teal/olive/gold multi-color ornamentation simplified to a cohesive neutral+accent system
Logo component simplified to a clean, professional mark — no ornate Cycladic arch with sun rays/horizon lines
Homepage maintains all existing functionality (auth-aware CTAs, i18n, pricing plans, theme toggle, locale switcher) with no regressions
Type check passes: bun run typecheck exits 0
Lint passes: bun run lint exits 0
Build succeeds: bun run build exits 0

constraints.answer: Must keep existing tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, next-intl, next-themes, lucide-react, Must not break existing i18n — all translation keys used in page.tsx must still resolve, Must preserve auth-aware behavior (logged-in users see Dashboard CTA, others see Sign In/Sign Up), Must keep next-themes dark mode working (light/dark variants), No new dependencies — use only what's already in package.json, Keep file structure: only edit src/app/page.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/common/Logo.tsx

assumptions.answer: The user granted full 'yolo' on typography, so I am deciding: keep Playfair Display for large headlines only (editorial elegance at the hero), Inter for all body/UI text (clean, modern, maximally readable). The redesign keeps the TOPOS 'place' concept but expresses it through architectural minimalism rather than decorative ornamentation. I assume: (1) retaining the deep Aegean blue as the single primary accent while simplifying the multi-color palette (terracotta/teal/olive/gold) into a cohesive neutral system; (2) the homepage section structure (hero, features, stats/testimonial, pricing, CTA, footer) is sound and only needs visual refinement, not reorganization; (3) keeping next-themes dark mode.

phases.name: Redesign Frontend
phases.goal: Transform the ornamental Aegean homepage into a clean, professional, minimalist design that matches the TOPOS brand, covering design system, logo, and page layout.

steps.description: Redesign globals.css: simplify the color palette to neutral+single-accent, remove ornamental utilities (texture-plaster, arch-top, divider-meander, grid-pattern-dot), keep essential shadows/animations but tone them down, refine dark mode to be clean rather than 'moonlit Cycladic'.
Simplify Logo.tsx: replace the ornate Cycladic arch mark (sun, rays, horizon, steps) with a clean, geometric, professional mark that evokes 'place' without decoration.

Redesign page.tsx: strip all decorative SVGs (arch, waves, blur orbs), remove plaster textures and meander dividers, apply clean minimal layout with generous whitespace, single primary CTA, refined typography hierarchy, simpler card styling.
Run full validation: typecheck, lint, and build to confirm no regressions across the redesign.

verification.command: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run build
